about_the_game:
This pack includes:

  • "Eva Woods" hero unlock;
  • "Urban Shadow" outfit;
  • Zombie Eliminator MP40 skin;
  • 700 Crowns.

Eva Woods is a metamorph. A difficult life from an early age taught her to lie and pretend to be someone else, and to hide in front of almost everyone.

Ability: "Mind Games"
You can make others see an object instead of you, so that you can suddenly attack them when they least expect it. Being an object, you see enemies more clearly, and dropping the disguise overloads the enemy's senses and he is blinded for a while. In addition, different categories of objects for transformation give you additional bonues.

Golden Crowns is an in-game currency that can be spent on:

  • Battle Pass which allows you to pass additional challenges and get unique rewards;
  • Unique outfits and gestures in the in-game store;
  • Exchange to Eternal Grace, which is the main currency accepted in the shadow realm, required for obtaining new mystic powers.

Note!

  • Refund is not provided if you purchase 2 different packs which include the same content!
  • Available only for Windows. You can't activate this item for the PSN or Xbox Live account, or the mobile version.
